info.title: API.SH: Samsung Brasil
info.description: The Samsung Brasil API from API.SH: public Samsung Brasil data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
What the Samsung Brasil store suggests as you type: suggested searches with the number of results and the category each leads to, plus up to 5 matching products with price, list price, image and availability. Without `query`, the store's top searches.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/samsung-br-autocomplete

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The start of a search, e.g. `galaxy s2`. Leave empty for the top searches.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The Samsung Brasil store's category tree (departments, categories, subcategories) with ids, names, links, SEO titles and descriptions. Each `path` works as `category` in search and filters.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/samsung-br-categories

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The filters (facets) the Samsung Brasil store offers for a search or category, with the number of products behind each value: department, category, subcategory, price ranges, colour, memory, size, technology and the rest. Each value carries a `filter` string to pass to `/samsung-br/v1/search` as `filters` (price ranges carry `min_price`/`max_price`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/samsung-br-filters

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search words. Optional when `category`, `collection` or `filters` is given.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Filters already applied (key:value pairs, comma separated), to see what is left.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Product families from the samsung.com/br catalogue by category (smartphones, tablets, watches, audio, TVs, monitors, refrigerators, washers and more), each with every model: model code, name, link, image, price, list price, promotion price, savings, stock status, rating and review count, colour/memory options, key specs, monthly payment offer and labels. The category's filters come back in `filters`, with codes to pass back as `filters`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/samsung-br-models

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: The category, or an 8-digit category code.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Filter codes from `filters[].options[].code`, comma separated, e.g. `01i01,07o11` (codes of one group are combined with OR, groups with AND).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One product from the Samsung Brasil store: name, title, brand, link, price range, list price, cash (Pix) price, best interest-free installment plan, availability, categories, highlights, collections, description, every specification (and the groups they belong to), variant options, and every variant (SKU) with model code, EAN, colour/memory, price, list price, cash price, stock quantity, price validity, installments per card brand (count, value, total, interest), promotions, gifts, sellers, images and videos, plus `raw`. Unknown products answer 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/samsung-br-product

parameters.name: product
parameters.description: The product: a store link (shop.samsung.com/br/<slug>/p), its slug (e.g. `galaxy-s25-ultra-512gb`), a product id (digits), a model code (e.g. `SM-S938BZKKZTO`), a samsung.com/br product link ending in a model code, or a 13-digit EAN. Or pass `sku`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Products the Samsung Brasil store links to a product: similar products, products bought together, viewed together, accessories, suggestions or shown together, each with prices, installments, availability and variants.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/samsung-br-related

parameters.name: product
parameters.description: A product id (digits), or anything `/samsung-br/v1/product` accepts.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Customer reviews of a Samsung model as samsung.com/br shows them (the model and its family): rating, title, text, ratings-only flag, recommendation, nickname, date, language, model, secondary ratings (features, performance, design, value...), context such as age, incentivised flag, photos, videos and brand responses, plus the rating breakdown for Brazil (`stats`) and for all countries (`stats_all_countries`). Brazilian reviews by default; `all_countries=1` adds reviews from other Samsung sites. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/samsung-br-reviews

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: A Samsung model code, e.g. `SM-S938BZKKZTO` (a variant's `model_code`). Or pass `product`.

parameters.name: product
parameters.description: Instead of `model`: anything `/samsung-br/v1/product` accepts; its first variant's model is used.

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Only these star ratings (1-5, comma separated).

parameters.name: all_countries
parameters.description: `1` to include reviews from other Samsung country sites.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search the official Samsung Brasil online store (shop.samsung.com/br) by keyword and/or category, with every filter the store offers (colour, memory, size, technology and the rest from `/samsung-br/v1/filters`), a price range, a collection (offers and campaigns) and the store's sorts. Each product comes with its price range, list price, cash (Pix) price, best interest-free installment plan, availability, categories, highlights, variant options and every variant (SKU) with model code, EAN, colour/memory, price, list price, stock, installments per card brand, sellers and images, plus the specifications and `raw`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/samsung-br-search

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search words (Portuguese or model names), e.g. `galaxy s25`, `geladeira`, `smart tv`. Optional when `category`, `collection`, `filters` or a price range is given.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: A category path from `/samsung-br/v1/categories` (department/category/subcategory), e.g. `mobile/smartphone/galaxy-s`, `eletrodomesticos`, or a store category link.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Facet filters as key:value pairs from `/samsung-br/v1/filters` (the `filter` field of each value), comma separated, e.g. `cor:preto,memoria:256-gb`.

parameters.name: collection
parameters.description: A collection id (digits) from a product's `collections` (offers, campaigns, launches).

parameters.name: in_stock
parameters.description: `1` to leave out products that are out of stock.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A delivery quote from the Samsung Brasil store for a product variant to a Brazilian CEP: availability, price, list price and each delivery option with its price, estimated business days, estimated date, transit time, carrier name and pickup point when there is one, plus the order totals. Pass `sku`, or `product` to quote its first available variant.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/samsung-br-shipping

parameters.name: cep
parameters.description: The destination CEP (8 digits, with or without the dash).

parameters.name: sku
parameters.description: A SKU id (digits) from a product's `variants`.

parameters.name: product
parameters.description: Instead of `sku`: anything `/samsung-br/v1/product` accepts; its first available variant is quoted.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
